en: The front of the postcard shows a colored illustration of a rural landscape with pine trees in the foreground, a few industrial buildings with smoking chimneys in the middle-ground, all set against green fields and wooded hills. The word 'PYRMONT' and 'Schellenberger' are printed on the image, and there is handwritten script below the illustration. The reverse side shows handwritten script in German, an address to 'Fräulein Marichen Cornelsen,' a German stamp from the 'Deutsches Reich' era, and markings indicating postal use. 'MUSEUM LAGLOS' is also stamped.
